description: Sample prompts categorized by expected fidelity level

high_fidelity.description: Prompts with mostly verified constraints, expected fidelity > 0.8

prompts.prompt: Action movies from the 80s rated above 7
prompts.notes: All constraints map to TMDb fields: genre, year range, vote_average

prompts.prompt: French films under 90 minutes
prompts.notes: Language and runtime are both verified fields

prompts.prompt: Movies directed by Ridley Scott with a budget over $50 million
prompts.notes: Director lookup + budget filter (post-filter from details)

prompts.prompt: Horror movies from Japan released after 2000
prompts.notes: Genre, country/language, year range

prompts.prompt: Comedies with Will Ferrell rated above 6
prompts.notes: Genre, cast lookup, rating filter

prompts.prompt: Sci-fi films between 1990 and 2000 with over 1000 votes
prompts.notes: Genre, date range, vote count

prompts.prompt: Documentary films about music
prompts.notes: Two genres combined

prompts.prompt: Korean thriller movies
prompts.notes: Language and genre

medium_fidelity.description: Prompts mixing verified and inferred constraints, expected fidelity 0.4-0.7

prompts.prompt: 90s thrillers that feel like a Coen Brothers film
prompts.notes: Decade + genre verified; Coen Brothers aesthetic is inferred

prompts.prompt: Sci-fi movies under 2 hours with a melancholy tone
prompts.notes: Genre + runtime verified; tone is inferred

prompts.prompt: Horror films from Japan that aren't jump-scare dependent
prompts.notes: Genre + language verified; scare style is inferred

prompts.prompt: Action movies with strong female leads from the 2010s
prompts.notes: Genre + decade verified; character archetype is inferred

prompts.prompt: Romantic comedies that don't follow the typical formula
prompts.notes: Genre verified; originality is inferred

prompts.prompt: War movies with anti-war themes
prompts.notes: Genre verified; thematic stance is inferred

prompts.prompt: Crime dramas with morally ambiguous protagonists
prompts.notes: Genres verified; moral complexity is inferred

prompts.prompt: Animated films suitable for adults, not Pixar or Disney
prompts.notes: Genre + exclusions verified; maturity level is inferred

low_fidelity.description: Prompts with mostly inferred constraints, expected fidelity < 0.4

prompts.prompt: Movies that feel like a rainy Sunday afternoon
prompts.notes: Pure mood/atmosphere, no verified fields

prompts.prompt: Films with the visual palette of a Vermeer painting
prompts.notes: Cinematography style, no API equivalent

prompts.prompt: Something that will make me rethink how I treat the people I love
prompts.notes: Emotional impact, purely inferred

prompts.prompt: Movies with Wes Anderson energy but not by Wes Anderson
prompts.notes: Stylistic comparison, inferred except for director exclusion

prompts.prompt: Films that feel like being 17 again
prompts.notes: Nostalgic emotional resonance, inferred

prompts.prompt: Movies where the ending completely recontextualizes everything
prompts.notes: Narrative structure, inferred

prompts.prompt: Something meditative and slow, like watching a river flow
prompts.notes: Pacing and mood, purely inferred

prompts.prompt: Films that capture the loneliness of modern city life
prompts.notes: Thematic content, inferred

prompts.prompt: Movies with a dreamlike quality that blur reality and fantasy
prompts.notes: Stylistic/tonal, inferred

prompts.prompt: Something existentially unsettling but ultimately hopeful
prompts.notes: Emotional arc, inferred

edge_cases.description: Interesting edge cases for testing the system

prompts.prompt: Good movies
prompts.notes: Extremely vague, should result in high fidelity (just rating filter)

prompts.prompt: Movies
prompts.notes: No constraints at all, fidelity should be 1.0 (trivially satisfied)

prompts.prompt: The best Christopher Nolan film about dreams
prompts.notes: Effectively asking for one specific movie (Inception)

prompts.prompt: Foreign films
prompts.notes: Ambiguous - 'foreign' relative to what? Tests interpretation

prompts.prompt: Movies like Blade Runner but not sci-fi
prompts.notes: Contradictory-ish: Blade Runner is definitionally sci-fi

prompts.prompt: Underrated gems from the 2000s
prompts.notes: 'Underrated' is subjective but could map to low vote count + high rating

prompts.prompt: Crowd-pleasers that aren't dumb
prompts.notes: Mixed: popularity verified, 'not dumb' is inferred

prompts.prompt: Movies my grandma would like
prompts.notes: Requires inferring demographic preferences

sequence: Drama movies from the 1990s rated above 7
